actions.documentation: Record a clean missed pinch of a loose part, without acquiring it.
actions.name: attempt_grasp

actions.documentation: Script an incompatible approach to a real joint, without attaching.
actions.name: attempt_direction

actions.documentation: Release the held part's supporting hand as a scripted slip or drop.
actions.name: release_part

actions.documentation: Put connector `using` of the held part into connector `at` of the built part `onto`, turned by `turn` degrees
actions.name: mate
actions.signature: mate(self, pid, using, onto, at, turn=0.0, slide=None, seat=1.0, flip=1, residual=None, within=None, in_hand=False, schema=None)

actions.documentation: Put a held part at pose T (its fully seated pose). seat<1 leaves it short of the seated pose along the
actions.name: place
actions.signature: place(self, pid, T, seat=1.0, start=False, within=None)

actions.documentation: Pick up a finished sub-assembly (both hands) and move it by the rigid transform M onto the build.
actions.name: attach

actions.documentation: Take a section (the given connected parts) off the build with both hands and set it down by the rigid
actions.name: detach

actions.documentation: Turn a separate model and return it to a supported table pose.
actions.name: turn_build
actions.signature: turn_build(self, pid, yaw=0.0, flip=False, pitch=0.0, roll=0.0)

actions.documentation: Pass a held part or connected model to the free hand.
actions.name: transfer

actions.documentation: Change a held object's grasp with temporary support from the free hand.
actions.name: regrasp

actions.documentation: Pick the model containing `pid` up in one hand, to build on it in the air (the other hand brings parts).
actions.name: hold_model

actions.documentation: Move/tilt an explicitly held connected model by rigid world displacement M (LDU).
actions.name: reorient_model

actions.documentation: Release the model on the table. For explicit holds, M chooses its rigid displacement;
actions.name: set_down_model

actions.documentation: Rotate a held loose part, lifting it clear before turning in the physical API.
actions.name: rotate_in_hand

actions.documentation: Steady a table-supported connected model without lifting it.
actions.name: brace_model

actions.documentation: Open the bracing hand only while the connected model stays stable.
actions.name: release_brace

actions.documentation: Rotate a connected branch around an existing round-bearing axis.
actions.name: articulate_connection
actions.signature: articulate_connection(self, pid, onto, angle, hand='R', using=None, at=None, pids=None)

actions.documentation: Open numbered bag `bag` and pour its parts onto the table. Precondition: both hands free, the bag is closed.
actions.name: open_bag

actions.documentation: Take a tool (the brick separator) from the table. Precondition: it is on the table, that hand is free.
actions.name: pick_tool

actions.documentation: Remove a built or supported unseated part with the held tool.
actions.name: pry

actions.documentation: Put the tool back on the table (at its spot, or at T).
actions.name: put_tool

actions.documentation: Scan the workspace with gaze. By default finish by looking at an available target.
actions.name: look_for

actions.documentation: Inspect a model, or check access to an obstructed part without touching it.
actions.name: inspect

actions.documentation: Point at a part with the index finger. Precondition: the part exists and a hand is free.
actions.name: point

actions.documentation: Look up from the table (at the person or device helping), for `seconds`.
actions.name: look_up

actions.documentation: Direct gaze to an authored scene point (LDraw units), without changing parts.
actions.name: look_at

actions.documentation: The hand hovers over a look-alike before going to `pid`. Precondition: the parts exist and a hand is free.
actions.name: hesitate

actions.documentation: A thinking pause: hands still, gaze on the work.
actions.name: pause

actions.documentation: Pause with attention on a part for the requested simulation time.
actions.name: notice

actions.documentation: Move one accessible loose piece aside, then settle the affected pile.
actions.name: sweep_part

actions.documentation: Open this hand now. Unsupported bodies retain their pose and velocity.
actions.name: open_hand

actions.documentation: Carry the connected body (target is the requested part's absolute world LDraw pose).
actions.name: move_held

actions.documentation: Advance headless gravity for all LEGO bodies by seconds (240 Hz clock).
actions.name: advance_time

scenario_labels.blocked_access: Geometry obstructs access to a target
scenario_labels.failed_recovery: Repair attempt leaves a problem unresolved
scenario_labels.inadequate_support: Insufficient support for the intended operation
scenario_labels.infeasible_manipulation: Simulator could not establish a feasible manipulation
scenario_labels.instruction_mismatch: Instructions belong to a different build or revision
scenario_labels.match_pose: Orient a part for the connection
scenario_labels.misaligned: Rest a piece beside its intended connection
scenario_labels.missing_part: A required part is absent from inventory
scenario_labels.not_seated: Leave a connected joint partly inserted
scenario_labels.too_few_copies: End the copy group short of its required count
scenario_labels.upside_down: Attach with the connector face reversed
scenario_labels.wrong_direction: Approach a joint along an incompatible axis
scenario_labels.wrong_part: Substitute the wrong design or colour

limitations: Strict anatomical contact is recorded as a label and not certified; acceptance uses visual geometric gates.
Timing dispersions and bounds are assumptions; no compatible held-out human event records.
Second-person physical assistance and mid-trajectory interventions are unsupported.
Downstream visual baselines and sim-to-real transfer were not run.
Procedural stud-grid assemblies only; installed catalog models failed qualification.
